answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 5589 Country: India Title: I have got a job (Executive) in a real estate company. Can you please tell me is it allowed for me. The company buys and sells properties and also provide returns to investors who invest in company's projects. Question: Assalamualikum,Mufti Saheb, I have got a job (Executive) in a real estate company. Can you please tell me is it allowed for me. The company buys and sells properties and also provide returns to investors who invest in company's projects. Khuda Hafiz Answer ID: 5589 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 654/606=D) How the company provide returns to the investors? And how this transaction is settled among them? Please, explain. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
